INSTALLATION SERVICE POINT
>>A<< TOPSTACK SIDE STAY PAD ASSEMBLY 
INSTALLATION
1. Face the folded end of the topstack side stay pad 
downward, and then position it to the No.1 bow side.
2. Connect the topstack side stay pad to the No.5, No.4, No.3, 
No.2 bows.
3. Insert the folded end of the topstack side stay pad through 
the wider part of the No.1 bow slit as shown.
4. Working from inside the vehicle, pull out the folded end of 
the topstack side stay pad, and then install the topstack side 
stay pad to the No.1 bow.
